page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with the printed page number at the head. No running head. The catchword "tradi-" sits at the lower right below the last line. The strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: qui hanc rem serio agimus, summa quæq; egerimus, semper tamen auxilio Dei & consilio majore indigebimus; quandoquidem Satan summus noster & concordiæ hostis, facile suos noverit invenire; per quos summa imis contutbet, ut nihil sit opus, nos diffidentiæ vel suspicionibus invicem indulgere, sed comprimis necessarium ut corda simul & dextras mutuò porrigamus, ne posteriora fiant deteriora prioribus.

32 Similiter Euangelicæ ecclesiæ in Poloniâ, Bohemiâ, aliisq; locis, partim Augustanam, partim Bohemicam, partim Hussiticam, partim Helveticam confessionem profitentes sanctum in religione christianâ consensum sanciverunt, non obstantibus quorundam rituum atq; opinionum differentiis.
33 Et licet neque illic desint homines turbulenti, qui concordiam ecclesiarum suis calumniis, obtrectationibus, susurris, & variis contradi-

page.notes: Printing error left as printed: "contutbet" (line 7 of the first paragraph). The left-edge strip with fragments of rotated text belongs to the neighbouring page and was excluded. No marginal notes on this page. The catchword "tradi-" is set at the lower right and is taken as a catchword, so the last paragraph ends with the full line "variis con-".
